description: Defines functions for determining default and specific PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) time-domain resource allocations based on 3GPP TS 38.214 specifications, including configurations for different RNTI types and cyclic prefixes.

methods.name: pdsch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get
methods.description: Calculates the default PDSCH time-domain resource allocation for configuration A based on cyclic prefix, row index, and DM-RS position.

methods.name: pdsch_default_time_allocations_default_A_table
methods.description: Provides a table of default PDSCH time-domain resource allocations for configuration A based on cyclic prefix and DM-RS position.

methods.name: get_c_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Returns a list of valid PDSCH time-domain allocations for a given search space configuration, active BWP, and DM-RS position.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Provides a list of valid PDSCH time-domain allocations scheduled with SI-RNTI Type0.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_type0A_common_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Provides a list of valid PDSCH time-domain allocations scheduled with SI-RNTI Type0A.

methods.name: get_ra_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Returns a list of valid PDSCH time-domain allocations scheduled with RA-RNTI.
